why: Real English word (to hit; a dance), correctly spelled by sound /bɒp/ — the Read Lexicon just omits informal words. Lesson 1 teaches only 𐑐 𐑚 𐑪, so pop/bob/bop are the only real words it can build.
The -ed suffix, quoted in the body of lesson 39 while teaching it. An affix, not a word, so the lexicon has no entry.
The -ing suffix, quoted in the body of lesson 50 while teaching how to write it. An affix, not a word, so the lexicon has no entry.
Deliberately wrong, and named as wrong: lesson 48 shows 𐑭𐑮 as the vowel-plus-𐑮 a writer is tempted to write for 'car' before teaching the single r-vowel 𐑸. Not a spelling the curriculum asserts.
